# Templates

One template, because only one document here is long enough to need a skeleton.

| Situation | Template | Goes to |
|---|---|---|
| "Only a human can do this part — dashboard, DNS, secrets" | [`runbook.md`](runbook.md) | `docs/runbooks/<topic>.md` |

There are deliberately no spec or plan templates. Features start with a rendered design, not a
document — see [`AGENTS.md` §1](../../AGENTS.md). What a plan used to carry now lives in the
prototype's handoff contract, derived from a design the owner has already approved.

Everything else — decisions, bugs, gaps, deferrals, open questions, ideas — is appended to its
register file, and each register states its own format at the top.
